deals.comment: Kream Corporation agreed to acquire Namaein Co., Ltd. for KRW 8 billion on August 20, 2021. As reported, Kream Corporation will acquire 10,000 shares in Namaein Co., Ltd. for a cash consideration. At the end of 2020, Namaein Co., Ltd reported total assets of KRW 151 million, total debr of KRW 20 million, total equity of KRW 131 million, sales of KRW 409 million and net income of KRW 130 million. The Board of Directors of Kream Corporation resolved the transaction on August 20, 2021. The expected acquisition date is September 29, 2021.

Kream Corporation agreed to acquire Namain Korea Co., Ltd. from Park, Woo-jin for KRW 8 billion on August 20, 2021. As per the transaction, Kream Corporation will acquire 10000 shares of Namain Korea Co., Ltd. Namain Korea Co., Ltd. generated total assets of KRW 11.1 billion at the end of the most recent business year. The transaction is expected to close on September 29, 2021.

Kream Corporation agreed to acquire a 3% stake in CHEXCAR Inc. for KRW 1.5 billion on May 16, 2022. Under the transaction, Kream Corporation will acquire 25,956 shares of Cheka Co., Ltd. and consideration will be paid in cash. CHEXCAR Inc. reported total assets of KRW 9.65 billion, total debt of KRW 6.93 billion, total equity of KRW 2.72 billion and net income of KRW 42 million. Transaction is expected to close on May 27, 2022.
Kream Corporation agreed to acquire 22.47% stake in Shake Hands Sdn Bhd for KRW 2.232 billion on July 18, 2022. Transaction is expected to be completed on July 29, 2022.
Kream Corporation entered into an agreement to acquire 51.75% stake in Team Plus Co., Ltd for KRW 4.4 million on February 22, 2023. The deal is expected to complete on March 3, 2023.
